channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O Estado que os candidatos de 2026 não sabem soletrar – parte 1
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that violence, economy, and corruption are the top concerns among Brazilians in 2025, with violence leading the agenda. Although homicides have decreased, feminicides hit a record high and police-related deaths remain elevated, posing major challenges for public security in the 2026 elections. The debate is likely to be shaped by quick-fix promises and penal populism.

item.title: Lula, Alcolumbre e Motta juntos, até que as emendas os separem
item.description: President Lula had lunch with the Senate and Chamber presidents, emphasizing the importance of institutional progress. The meeting took place amid discussions on reforms and the legislative agenda for his second term.

item.title: O ponto que interessa: Lula sabia das atividades de Lulinha em Brasília?
item.description: The report uncovers that MChecon, linked to lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and President Lula's son Lulinha, secured 13 government contracts after Lula's third term, totaling $63.4 million. The connection emerged from messages where Lulinha allegedly referenced businessman Marcelo Checon to obtain funds.

item.title: Caiado defende parceria estrangeira para desenvolver minerais críticos
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado defended foreign partnerships to develop critical minerals processing technology, claiming agreements with the US and Japan do not compromise Brazilian sovereignty. He highlighted the creation of state institutions to add value to minerals, preventing raw material exports.

item.title: TRE-DF divide tempos de propaganda na TV para campanhas. Confira
item.description: The Electoral Regional Court of the Federal District (TRE-DF) has allocated free electoral advertising time on TV and radio among the coalitions running for the Government of the Federal District in the 2026 elections. The largest share was assigned to the 'Propósito e Ação' coalition, led by Celina Leão (PP), with 5 minutes and 11 seconds per block and 566 insertions. Other coalitions, including the PT, PSol, Rede and PDT federation, and the 'Resgatar Brasília' coalition, were also allocated time and insertions.

item.title: Renan Santos defende que Justiça do Trabalho caminhe para 'obsolescência e substituição'
item.description: Renan Santos, a presidential candidate from the Mission party, advocates for the obsolescence and replacement of the Labor Justice system, proposing that labor demands be resolved in Civil Justice. He criticizes Brazil's labor justice as the worst in the world and suggests a labor reform with a weekly hour cap, minimum rest period, and hourly payment.

item.title: Modelo brasileira perde coroa de miss e aponta gravidez como motivo
item.description: Model Lara Marina had her Miss Supranational Brazil crown revoked by the National Beauty Contest after a pregnancy was discovered, which she says motivated the decision. The organization cited breach of contractual obligations, while Lara emphasized that the pregnancy does not erase her achievements and reaffirmed her commitment to her professional projects.

item.title: Agregador Carta/Colectta aponta disputa apertada entre Lula e Flávio no 2º turno
item.description: The Carta/Collecta aggregator shows a tight race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a possible second round, with a 2.9-point lead for the president. The tool aggregates electoral polls registered with the Electoral Justice and projects candidates based on a daily-updated weighted moving average.

item.title: Agregador Carta/Colectta: Lula tem quase 5 pontos de vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no 1º turno
item.description: The Carta/Coletiva Aggregator shows Lula at 40.3% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 35.6% in the 2026 first-round poll projections, maintaining a polarized race. Other candidates such as Renan Santos, Ronaldo Caiado, and Pablo Marçal trail with much lower percentages.

item.title: O erro grosseiro do governo com a arrecadação do imposto sobre dividendos
item.description: The federal government significantly miscalculated revenue projections for the minimum tax on dividends, collecting only 1.42 billion reais by May 2026 against 29.94 billion expected. This shortfall threatens public accounts balance and increases market distrust in Lula's fiscal management.

item.title: Caiado diz que PT entregou soberania a PCC e Comando Vermelho
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, presidential candidate from PSD, claimed that PT allegedly handed over sovereignty to PCC and Comando Vermelho, highlighting their control over certain territories. In an interview with TMC 360, he advocated for greater use of technology and artificial intelligence in public security. He also supported international agreements for processing critical minerals, denying any threat to national sovereignty.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Alcolumbre dá vitórias a Lula, mas guarda cartas na manga para jogadas seguintes
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre, president of the Senate, granted victories to President Lula's government, including the imminent approval of the MP on the 'blusinhas' tax. However, he is holding back other strategic moves for the coming months, particularly regarding the constitutional amendment bills (PECs) on the 6×1 workweek and Public Security, which will only advance in the special committee. The Senate leadership balances support for the government with alliances to secure his reelection in 2027.

item.title: TSE e Google lançam ferramenta para candidatos identificarem deepfakes no YouTube
item.description: The TSE and Google launched a partnership to protect candidates in the 2026 elections from deepfakes on YouTube using the Likeness ID tool to identify synthetic content. The initiative allows politicians to monitor misuse of their images and requires identity verification to access the tool.

item.title: Caiado diz que jovens não querem mais CLT e chama modelo de “arcaico”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, former governor of Goiás and presidential candidate for the PSD, stated that young people no longer want to work under the CLT, calling the model 'archaic'. He advocates for new work organization models inspired by developed countries, considering digitalization and artificial intelligence.

item.title: Com ajuda de Motta e Alcolumbre, Lula tenta sair do sufoco do caso Lulinha
item.description: Amid revelations about alleged benefits received by relatives and an aide from a lobbyist, President Lula hosted a lunch with congressional leaders to reshape his agenda and divert the campaign from ongoing investigations. He proposed progress on issues like ending the 6×1 workday, creating the Ministry of Public Security, and discussing a constitutional amendment on critical minerals, in a move seen as having strong electoral motivations.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro reforça estratégia digital e avalia 'TV própria' 24 horas até o fim da eleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) 2026 campaign is planning to launch a 24-hour YouTube TV channel, strengthening its digital strategy and continuous media presence throughout the election period.

item.title: Bomba atômica com democracia frágil é risco de ditadura eterna
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos proposes that Brazil develop a nuclear bomb to strengthen sovereignty, but warns about the risk of a permanent dictatorship if nuclear weapons fall into authoritarian hands. His proposals include urban favela removal, non-compliance with judicial decisions, and pension reform, but raise concerns about democratic fragility.

item.title: Caiado diz que Brasil não pode usar a China como referência
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, a presidential candidate from PSD, stated that Brazil should not adopt the Chinese model as a reference due to differences in labor, environmental rules, and government participation in companies. In an interview with TMC 360, he advocated for an open but fair market, criticizing unequal competition with China and Paraguay. Caiado noted that Brazilian entrepreneurs are moving to Paraguay due to favorable tax conditions, threatening the local economy.

item.title: Deputados são eleitos pelo voto proporcional; entenda a lógica desse sistema
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections include proportional representation for federal deputies, state deputies, and councilors, where votes for candidates also count as votes for their parties. The electoral quotient determines the number of seats each party or federation receives, with remaining seats allocated by the largest averages method. Party federations can combine votes in proportional elections.

item.title: Caiado defende debate sobre fim da escala 6 X 1 com setor produtivo
item.description: Caiado advocates for debating the end of the 6 x 1 work schedule with the productive sector before moving forward in Congress, highlighting concerns from small business owners about economic impacts. He criticizes the federal government's rush to vote on the proposal and suggests prioritizing interest rate reduction.

item.title: Adversários do PT no Nordeste apostam em ‘voto casado’ com Lula e desafiam palanques de Flávio
item.description: Northeastern candidates not aligned with Lula use the split ticket strategy to attract voters, while PT tries to dissociate itself. The strategy aims to weaken Lula's support and hinder Flávio Bolsonaro's alliance building.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quinta-feira
item.description: Presidential candidates carry out campaign activities on Thursday, including debates, hospital visits, markets and workplaces, along with walks and rallies with supporters. Lula participates in a debate on TV Globo, while Caiado and Costa Pimenta give interviews and visit institutions. The agenda focuses on grassroots actions and proposal dissemination in the states.

item.title: Crusoé: “Juntos para sempre”
item.description: President Lula (PT) seeks to consolidate alliances in the National Congress amid declining popularity and investigations involving his son. The meeting with legislative leaders aims to secure support for the government agenda.

item.title: Pesquisa Poder/Aya indica empate técnico entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no 1º e no 2º turnos
item.description: A recent survey shows a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro in both the first and second rounds, with the difference within the two-point margin of error. Lula held 38% of voter intentions in the first round, followed by Flávio at 35%, while other second-round matchups also showed technical ties in three of the four simulated scenarios.

item.title: O que Davide Ancelotti tem a ensinar sobre a Inteligência do Brasil?
item.description: The text compares the Brazilian Intelligence Agency (Abin) to a football technical team, highlighting Davide Ancelotti's role as a data analyst supporting decision-making, similar to how Abin supports the state. It emphasizes the need to modernize intelligence legislation, based on Bill 6.423/2025, and points to real examples of Abin's actions in security operations and threat prevention.

item.title: Critério proposto por Mendonça para identificar deepfakes é sensato
item.description: Minister André Mendonça proposed criteria to identify deepfakes in elections, requiring AI-generated content with high realism to be classified as prohibited deepfakes. The initiative aims to differentiate legitimate, labeled content from misleading material that confuses voters.

item.title: Tarcísio enrola Flávio em ‘relação tóxica’
item.description: The PL presidential candidate, Flávio Bolsonaro, relies on a strategic alliance with São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas to expand his voter base in the country's largest electoral college and offset Lula's lead in the Northeast. However, Tarcísio has been avoiding public meetings with Flávio, adopting a distant stance.

item.title: Lula participa de entrevista da Globo nesta quinta-feira; saiba como assistir
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) takes part this Thursday in a live Globo interview right after the nightly news, broadcast simultaneously on GloboNews and g1. The interview is part of the 2026 presidential race coverage, hosted by journalists Renata Vasconcellos and César Tralli.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Instagram domina redes declaradas por candidatos; 13% não informam nenhuma
item.description: A g1 survey reveals that 74% of candidates registered at least one Instagram account with the TSE, followed by Facebook (49%) and TikTok (24%). Approximately 13% of candidates did not declare any social media or electoral website. Data was updated until August 25th and may change with new filings or judicial decisions.

item.title: Caso ‘Dark Horse’ envolve lançamento pós-eleição, perícia e apuração no STF; veja os detalhes do filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, will be released after the elections but faces suspicions of irregular funding through Vorcaro and Banco Master, triggering investigations at the STF. Flávio Bolsonaro tries to distance himself, but the production company has not detailed expenses.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: relator apresenta hoje texto à comissão do Senado
item.description: The rapporteur of the PEC to end the 6x1 workweek, Senator Omar Aziz, presents his report to the Senate CCJ on Thursday, keeping the text approved by the Chamber. The expectation is to vote on the report next week, with pressure from President Lula's government for approval before the October elections.

item.title: A participação de Washington nas eleições no Brasil
item.description: The US will not directly influence the 2026 Brazilian elections, although the State Department appears to favor Flávio Bolsonaro. The outcome will depend on internal campaign dynamics in Brazil, and relations between Washington and Brasília are expected to improve once the winner is known.

item.title: Governo não espera solução rápida para tarifaço, mesmo com retomada das negociações com os EUA
item.description: The federal government does not expect a quick resolution to the tariff hikes imposed by the US, even with negotiations resuming. Government officials say it will be difficult to reach an agreement before the October elections. The upcoming meeting between Brazil and the US will focus on lowering tariffs on ethanol and sugar.

item.title: TSE recebe 5 mil denúncias de irregularidades eleitorais nos 10 primeiros dias de campanha
item.description: In the first 10 days of the 2026 electoral campaign, the TSE received 5,000 complaints of irregularities through the Pardal app, with emphasis on state deputies (1,943 cases) and federal deputies (1,641 cases). The main violations involve posting campaign materials in public areas and online advertising without proper identification.

item.title: Escala 6x1: governistas articulam para que proposta seja votada em plenário na semana que vem, antes das eleições
item.description: Government supporters in the Senate are pushing to vote on the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale before the elections, through accelerated proceedings in the Constitution and Justice Committee and potential floor discussion next week. The strategy aims to use the last voting window before the first electoral round, but requires approval from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: Sem Lulinha e com Bolsonaro, Lula e Flávio estreiam no horário eleitoral na TV; veja os detalhes
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro debut in the electoral time slot with different strategies: Lula highlights his trajectory and support for women, while Flávio addresses public security and cost of life, initially avoiding a more confrontational stance.

item.title: “Vai ter regime de exceção para retomar a favela”, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos proposed a state of exception in favelas and the construction of 10 prisons with 6 billion reais to combat organized crime. His plan includes measures inspired by Nayib Bukele's model and aims to retake territories controlled by factions within one year.

item.title: Grilagem e publicidade: MP de Roraima vai investigar Denarium e Damião
item.description: The Roraima Public Prosecutor's Office (MPRR) opened investigations into former governors Antonio Denarium and Edilson Damião for alleged advertising irregularities and land-grabbing schemes. The case, initially filed with the Federal Public Prosecutor by Nicoletti, was transferred to MPRR, while the TSE had already annulled their mandates for electoral violations.

item.title: PSDB, Cidadania e PDT pedem que Aécio Neves dispute o Senado
item.description: The PSDB, Cidadania, and PDT in Minas Gerais requested that Aécio Neves reconsider his decision not to run in the 2026 elections and instead pursue a Senate seat, following Marcelo Heringer's withdrawal. Aécio stated his decision to step back was difficult but firm, and he has not yet responded to the appeal.

item.title: Vasco vence o Vitória pela Copa do Brasil com um jogador a menos
item.description: Vasco defeated Vitória 1-0 in the Brazil Cup match with a goal from Andrés Gómez, playing with one fewer player after Barros' red card. The return match will be at Barradão.

item.title: Flávio tem 33% e Lula 27% das intenções de voto em MS, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on August 25, 2026 shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads voter intentions in Mato Grosso do Sul with 33%, followed by Lula (PT) with 27% in the first round. The survey, conducted between August 21 and 24 with 804 respondents, has a margin of error of 3 percentage points and was funded by TV Morena.

item.title: Brasileiros temem votar em NY, e Brasil busca centro de votação protegido do ICE
item.description: Brazilian immigrants in New Jersey avoid voting in the October 4th elections due to fear of ICE actions. Brazil seeks to establish a protected polling station against the US immigration agency.

item.title: Tarcísio x Haddad: nova pesquisa AtlasIntel mede corrida pelo governo de São Paulo
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll projects the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial and Senate races, featuring Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad as frontrunners. The survey includes 1,800 respondents and will be released in September, covering seven candidates in the first round and 15 for the Senate.

item.title: Renan Santos na TV Globo: veja como colunistas do GLOBO avaliaram a sabatina do candidato à Presidência
item.description: Renan Santos participated in an interview on TV Globo, becoming the third candidate among six scheduled for the week. GLOBO columnists evaluated his performance, following previous analyses of Zema and Caiado. Coverage highlights ratings and opinions from commentators about the Missao Party candidate.

item.title: A nova pesquisa AtlasIntel sobre disputa Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll measures the presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil's largest electoral college, São Paulo, with 1,800 interviews and release scheduled for September 1, 2026. The questionnaire lists twelve candidates for the first round and tests Lula in four possible second-round scenarios, including matchups against Flávio, Zema, Caiado, and Renan Santos. It also analyzes the state race between Fernando Haddad and Tarcísio de Freitas, covering issues such as security, education, and healthcare.

item.title: Renan Santos usa Flamengo e Palmeiras como exemplos para gerir dívida
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão) used the financial management of Palmeiras and Flamengo as an example for his proposal to handle Brazil's public debt during a Jornal Nacional interview. He stated that Brazil manages its public accounts like clubs that failed to make adjustments and went bankrupt. He also cited measures adopted by El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele as a reference for public security, defending that 'the blood that must spill is that of the criminal'.

item.title: A estratégia de Lula para desviar foco de seu principal problema na campanha
item.description: Lula seeks to steer the campaign toward electoral issues such as public security and the economy, diverting attention from investigations involving his son and allies. According to columnist Robson Bonin, this strategy aims to build a positive agenda, though the proposals lack immediate concrete outcomes.

item.title: Saiba quais medidas o governo exige do Discord na ação da AGU
item.description: The federal government, through the AGU, filed a lawsuit against Discord in the Federal Court, demanding digital safety measures for children, teens, and women, plus R$500 million in collective moral damages. Requirements include real-time blocking of suicide and violence content, age verification, parental controls for minors, and Portuguese-speaking moderation. The action follows a meeting at Palácio da Alvorada with President Lula and Attorney General Jorge Messias.

item.title: Representantes de Flávio, Lula e Caiado defendem atuação do poder público no transporte
item.description: Representatives of Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula, and Ronaldo Caiado advocate for federal intervention in public transport, though they differ on implementation. Giancarlo proposes direct subsidies with conditions; Daniella suggests an indirect model via public banks; and Adriano supports an interfederative subsidy model.

item.title: Renan Santos fala em ‘banho de sangue’ de bandidos e defende bomba atômica do Brasil
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party in 2026, advocated for 'bloodbath' against criminals and for Brazil to develop nuclear weapons to ensure sovereignty and compete with global powers. He also proposed a 'war' against organized crime groups like PCC and Comando Vermelho, and criticized Brazil's alignment with China under Lula's administration.
